newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portugal Telecom nudges all-time high.
newsitem.headline: Portugal Telecom nudges all-time high.

text.p: Shares of Portugal Telecom rose 2.25 percent to close at an all-time high of 7,000 escudos, in line with a higher close on Wall Street and benefiting from a stronger dollar, dealers said.
"The dollar is strong (against the escudo), the stock is rising in the U.S., and there must be some transactions to adjust the Lisbon price to the Wall Street level," a dealer said.
Another said: "There is national and foreign buying interest. Support for PT is between 6,950 and 6,975 escudos."
PT traded at 6,995 escudos, up 159, in volume of 547,590 at 1524 GMT.
